0022600096.text: The Magic (0-1, 11th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 1 game back) host the Timberwolves (1-0, 4th in the West, 2nd in the Northwest) in Orlando's second game of the season. Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The Magic won their last meeting 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026, and took both 2025-26 games in the season series, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
